<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LANParty"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Start planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive list of games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare date and games in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProposeDate" name="Propose the date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDateAgreement" name="Receive date agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateAccepted" name="Do 8 or more people agree?" default="Flow_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all requested games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesAvailable" name="Are all requested games available?" default="Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after game check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Date accepted and game preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBeerRequirement" name="Find out how much beer friends require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBeer" name="Check whether there is enough beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Is there enough beer?" default="Flow_20">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue after beer check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_ProposeDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProposeDate" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDateAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_DateAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${agreeingPeople >= 8}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAccepted" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="All games available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allGamesAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBeerRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBeerRequirement" targetRef="Task_CheckBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enoughBeer}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Planner" name="Planner" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Proposed date" sourceRef="Task_ProposeDate" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateAgreement" name="Date agreement" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BeerRequirement" name="Beer requirement" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBeerRequirement"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
